detached_structure.evidence: A small reddish-brown structure sits in the backyard south of the house, near a square patio with a fire pit. It could be a shed or a playhouse.

signals.notes: Large mature trees cover the east and north sides of the central lot and hide much of the yard. Two vehicles are parked in the driveway on the north side. A blue tarp or pool-like cover is visible on the neighboring lot to the west, not the central lot.
